item.text:
The report now documents twenty-one reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F21: observer sync auto-unboxes a missing commit zxid at `UPTODATE`**. After a `DIFF`, one `PROPOSAL`, and `UPTODATE`, the observer cleanup loop sees `packetsCommitted` empty and evaluates `p.hdr.getZxid() != zxid` with a null `Long` zxid. The repro observed:

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "java.lang.Long.longValue()" because "zxid" is null
  at org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.Learner.syncWithLeader(Learner.java:855)
AssertionError: observer sync auto-unboxed a missing commit zxid
```

Reproduction: [ObserverSyncEmptyRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/observer_sync_empty/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/ObserverSyncEmptyRepro.java).

F21 is separate from the follower sync null-dereference findings F19/F20. The other twenty findings remain documented, including snapshot fallback, truncation/epoch recovery, oracle election/revalidation, malformed transaction handling, follower proposal handling, and duplicate/empty-record issues. All reproduction files and observed outputs remain under `repro/`; the captured source was not modified.
